title: Oscillometry and Machine Learning Approaches
official: Feasibility Study of Forced Oscillometry in the Prediction of Chronic Respiratory Diseases Using Machine Learning Approaches
summary: Unicentric retrospective study designed to analyses the performance of various machine learning approaches to predict patterns of chronic respiratory diseases such as asthma, based mainly on clinical information and respiratory spirometry/oscillometry.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 - 90 years
* Spirometry available
* Confirmed clinical diagnosis of COPD, asthma, interstitial lung disease according to national or international guidelines

Exclusion Criteria:

* Acute respiratory infection
